papers.title: The effect of a smartphone-based educational intervention on the supportive care needs of family caregivers of patients with colorectal cancer: a randomized controlled trial
papers.journal_full: Supportive care in cancer : official journal of the Multinational Association of Supportive Care in Cancer
papers.authors: Nemati H, Ehsani M, Farahani M, Brant J, Haghani S
papers.abstract:
PURPOSE: This study aimed to determine the effect of implementing a smartphone-based educational program on the supportive care needs of family caregivers of patients with colorectal cancer (CRC).
METHODS: This experimental study, designed as a randomized controlled trial (RCT), was conducted among family caregivers of patients with CRC in two teaching hospitals affiliated with Iran University of Medical Sciences in Tehran. A total of 80 caregivers were randomly assigned to either the intervention or control group. The intervention group received a smartphone-based educational program designed to meet their supportive care needs, while the control group received routine care. The Supportive Care Needs Survey-Partners and Caregivers (SCNS-P&C) was completed by both groups before and 4 weeks after the intervention. The total score of the SCNS-P&C ranged from 39 to 195. Higher scores on the overall scale and on each of its dimensions indicated greater supportive care needs in the corresponding domain. Data were analyzed using descriptive statistics, t-tests, and repeated-measures ANCOVA (p < 0.05) in SPSS version 16.
RESULTS: Findings indicated a reduction in total supportive care needs, and its four dimensions-health care service needs, psychological and emotional needs, work and social needs, and information needs-was significantly greater in the intervention group compared to the control group (p < 0.001).
CONCLUSION: This study found that family caregivers of patients with colorectal cancer who participated in a smartphone-based educational program reported greater reductions in supportive care needs over 1 month than those in the control group. These findings suggest that smartphone-based educational interventions may be a promising approach to supporting family caregivers.

papers.title_zh: 智慧型手機衛教介入對大腸直腸癌病人家庭照顧者支持性照護需求之影響：隨機對照試驗
papers.abstract_zh: 目的：本研究旨在探討實施智慧型手機衛教方案對大腸直腸癌（CRC）病人家庭照顧者支持性照護需求的影響。方法：本實驗性研究採隨機對照試驗（RCT）設計，於伊朗醫學大學附屬兩間德黑蘭教學醫院之CRC病人家庭照顧者中進行。共80名照顧者隨機分配至介入組或對照組。介入組接受針對其支持性照護需求設計之智慧型手機衛教方案，對照組接受常規照護。兩組均於介入前及介入後4週完成支持性照護需求量表-伴侶與照顧者版（SCNS-P&C）。SCNS-P&C總分範圍為39至195分，整體量表及各分量表分數越高，代表該領域支持性照護需求越大。資料以描述性統計、t檢定及重複測量共變數分析（ANCOVA）進行分析（p<0.05），使用SPSS第16版。結果：研究發現，介入組在總支持性照護需求及其四個維度——健康照護服務需求、心理與情緒需求、工作與社會需求、資訊需求——的降幅均顯著大於對照組（p<0.001）。結論：本研究發現，參與智慧型手機衛教方案的大腸直腸癌病人家庭照顧者，在1個月內支持性照護需求的降幅大於對照組。此結果顯示智慧型手機衛教介入可能是支持家庭照顧者的一種有前景的方法。
papers.score_reason: 單中心小樣本（n=80）、追蹤僅4週、僅報p值無實際分數，且對象為照顧者非病人本身，對外科臨床決策幫助有限。
papers.relevance_why: 研究對象為照顧者的心理社會支持性需求，非病人手術或腫瘤治療結果，屬非外科介入。

papers.action: 目前不需改變外科實務；此為照顧者衛教而非病人手術照護，可作為多學科團隊參考但非優先讀全文項目。

papers.title: Cardiac metastases from colorectal cancer: a comprehensive systematic review of clinical presentation, cardiac involvement, and outcomes
papers.authors: Abdul-Hafez H, Awashra A, Elgendy M, Rakab M, Ali A, Mahafdah B
papers.abstract: Cardiac metastasis from colorectal cancer (CRC) is exceedingly rare and remains poorly defined in the literature. As survival improves and metastatic patterns evolve, recognizing the clinical and anatomical characteristics of cardiac involvement is increasingly important. This systematic review synthesizes published cases of CRC with cardiac metastases identified through a systematic search to clarify presentation, metastatic pathways, management, and outcomes. Following PRISMA 2020 guidelines, we systematically searched PubMed, Scopus, and Web of Science from inception to October 2025 for case reports and case series describing CRC metastasis to the heart. Eligible reports were screened by two independent authors. Detailed clinical, pathological, imaging, management, and outcome data were extracted using a standardized template. Descriptive statistics were performed using Jamovi v2.7 without inferential analyses given the nature of the data. Fifty-three cases met inclusion. The mean age was 62.7 ± 11.75 years (median 66; IQR 55.5-71), with a slight male predominance (53.8%). Left-sided primaries were most common (50.9%), followed by rectal (26.4%) and right-sided tumors (15.1%). Most cardiac lesions were intracardiac (78%) and solitary (92.2%), with a marked predilection for the right ventricle (45.8%) and right atrium (35.4%). Dyspnea was the leading symptom (65.4%), while 19.2% were asymptomatic. Extra-cardiac metastases preceded cardiac involvement in 60.8%, mainly to the liver (46%) and lungs (32%). Curative-intent treatment was attempted in 52.8%; palliative care in 28.3%. Overall mortality was 64.2%. CRC cardiac metastasis typically manifests as a solitary right-sided intracavitary lesion in the context of systemic disease and carries a poor prognosis. Early multimodality imaging and individualized multidisciplinary management are essential. Collaborative registries are needed to establish evidence-based guidance.
papers.title_zh: 大腸直腸癌之心臟轉移：臨床表現、心臟侵犯型態與預後的全面系統性回顧
papers.abstract_zh: 大腸直腸癌（CRC）心臟轉移極為罕見，文獻定義仍不明確。隨著存活率提升與轉移模式演變，辨識心臟侵犯的臨床與解剖特徵日益重要。本系統性回顧透過系統性搜尋整合已發表之CRC心臟轉移病例，以闡明其表現方式、轉移途徑、處置與預後。依循PRISMA 2020指引，我們系統性搜尋PubMed、Scopus及Web of Science自建庫起至2025年10月，納入描述CRC心臟轉移之病例報告與病例系列。合格文獻由兩位獨立作者篩選。使用標準化表格提取詳細臨床、病理、影像、處置與預後資料。因資料性質，僅以Jamovi v2.7進行描述性統計，未進行推論性分析。共53例符合納入條件。平均年齡62.7±11.75歲（中位數66歲；IQR 55.5-71），男性略多（53.8%）。左側原發腫瘤最常見（50.9%），其次為直腸（26.4%）與右側腫瘤（15.1%）。多數心臟病灶為心內型（78%）且單一（92.2%），明顯偏好右心室（45.8%）與右心房（35.4%）。呼吸困難為主要症狀（65.4%），19.2%無症狀。60.8%病例心外轉移先於心臟侵犯出現，主要轉移至肝臟（46%）與肺臟（32%）。52.8%嘗試根治性治療，28.3%接受緩和治療。整體死亡率為64.2%。CRC心臟轉移典型表現為全身性疾病背景下之單一右側心內病灶，預後不佳。早期多模式影像檢查與個別化多學科管理至關重要。需建立合作性登記系統以制定實證指引。
papers.score_reason: 為病例報告/病例系列之系統性彙整，無對照組、無推論統計，證據等級低，但提供罕見疾病實務參考價值。
papers.relevance_why: 心臟轉移為CRC極罕見表現（僅53例可查文獻），台灣大腸直腸外科日常臨床少會遇到。
papers.one_liner: 彙整53例CRC心臟轉移病例，發現多為右心腔單一心內病灶，整體死亡率64.2%。
papers.action: 遇CRC病人合併不明原因心臟腫塊或右心腔病灶時，提高警覺並安排心臟影像評估；一般臨床常規不需改變。

pico.I: 無特定介入；描述性分析臨床表現、影像與治療型態
pico.O: 主要：臨床表現、心臟侵犯部位與型態、整體死亡率；次要：治療方式（根治性/緩和性）、心外轉移先後順序

右心室45.8%、右心房35.4%為最常見侵犯部位，92.2%為單一病灶
60.8%病例心外轉移（肝46%、肺32%）先於心臟侵犯出現

papers.title: Effect of JAK inhibitors on extraintestinal manifestations and concurrent immune-mediated inflammatory diseases in patients with inflammatory bowel disease
papers.authors: Truyens M, Tolstoy X, Calabrese G, Cremer A, Lewandowski K, Argyriou K
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND AND AIMS: Extraintestinal manifestations (EIMs) and immune-mediated inflammatory diseases (IMIDs) are common in inflammatory bowel diseases (IBD) and contribute substantially to morbidity. The aim was to evaluate the real-world effectiveness of JAK inhibitors on EIMs/IMIDs.
METHODS: This multicenter retrospective study included adults with ulcerative colitis (UC) or Crohn's disease (CD) and one or more EIM/IMID initiating a JAK inhibitor (tofacitinib, upadacitinib, or filgotinib). Baseline was defined as treatment initiation; EIM/IMID and IBD activity were assessed at fixed timepoints using physician global assessment. Response rates are reported as observed, with patients discontinuing for worsening of the manifestation counted as non-responders. Logistic and Cox regression analyses identified factors associated with response and treatment discontinuation.
RESULTS: A total of 246 patients were included; 67% had two or more prior advanced therapies. Peripheral spondyloarthritis (SpA) (48%) and axial SpA (43%) were the most prevalent EIMs/IMIDs. Peripheral SpA response rates were 82% post-induction and 74% at month 12; axial SpA response rates were 71% and 59%, respectively. Psoriasis response was observed in 65% post-induction and in 50% at month 12, and hidradenitis suppurativa response in 91% and 78%, respectively. Steroid-free clinical IBD remission was 58% at month 12, and was independently associated with peripheral SpA response (adjusted odds ratio [aOR] 4.2, 95% CI 1.2-14.7). Treatment was discontinued in 31%; factors associated with discontinuation were filgotinib use (adjusted hazard ratio [aHR] 3.0, 95% CI 1.4-6.2) and co-existing axial and peripheral SpA (aHR 2.8, 95% CI 1.5-5.1).
CONCLUSIONS: JAK inhibitors were associated with favorable physician-assessed outcomes for EIMs/IMIDs in treatment-experienced IBD patients. Co-existing axial and peripheral SpA was associated with treatment discontinuation, suggesting a more complex phenotype.
papers.title_zh: JAK抑制劑對發炎性腸道疾病患者腸道外表現及合併免疫媒介發炎性疾病之療效
papers.abstract_zh:
背景與目的：腸道外表現（EIMs）及免疫媒介發炎性疾病（IMIDs）在發炎性腸道疾病（IBD）中相當常見，並顯著增加疾病負擔。本研究目的為評估JAK抑制劑對EIMs/IMIDs的真實世界療效。

方法：此多中心回溯性研究納入患有潰瘍性結腸炎（UC）或克隆氏症（CD）並合併一項以上EIM/IMID、開始使用JAK抑制劑（tofacitinib、upadacitinib或filgotinib）的成人患者。基準點定義為治療起始時；EIM/IMID及IBD活動度以醫師整體評估於固定時間點評估。反應率以觀察值報告，因症狀惡化而停藥者計為無反應者。以邏輯回歸及Cox回歸分析找出與治療反應及停藥相關的因子。

結果：共納入246名患者；67%曾接受兩種以上先前的進階治療。周邊脊椎關節炎（SpA）（48%）及中軸型SpA（43%）為最常見的EIM/IMID。周邊SpA反應率在誘導治療後為82%，第12個月為74%；中軸型SpA反應率分別為71%及59%。乾癬反應率誘導後為65%，第12個月為50%；化膿性汗腺炎反應率誘導後為91%，第12個月為78%。第12個月時無類固醇之臨床IBD緩解率為58%，並與周邊SpA反應獨立相關（校正勝算比[aOR] 4.2，95% CI 1.2-14.7）。31%患者停藥；與停藥相關的因子包括使用filgotinib（校正風險比[aHR] 3.0，95% CI 1.4-6.2）及合併中軸與周邊SpA（aHR 2.8，95% CI 1.5-5.1）。

結論：JAK抑制劑在曾接受多種治療的IBD患者中，對EIMs/IMIDs顯示良好的醫師評估療效。合併中軸與周邊SpA與治療停藥相關，暗示此為較複雜的表現型。
papers.score_reason: 此為單臂回溯性觀察研究，無對照組，且主題屬IBD藥物治療腸道外症狀，非大腸直腸外科手術決策範疇，臨床可信度與外科實用性均有限。
papers.relevance_why: 本文探討JAK抑制劑對IBD腸道外表現之藥物治療效果，屬消化內科/風濕科範疇，非外科介入或手術決策議題。

papers.title: Neuro-immune interactions in colorectal cancer: mechanistic insights and therapeutic implications within the tumor immune microenvironment
papers.authors: Zhen H, Wang C, Wang X, Huang H, Li J, Zhao M
papers.abstract: Within the CRC microenvironment, neural and immunological systems constitute a regulatory axis with strong dynamism and bidirectionality, thereby profoundly influencing tumor initiation, immune evasion, and therapeutic resistance. Here, we systematically outline the anatomical as well as functional underpinnings, the molecular mechanisms, and the translational potential of neuro-immune crosstalk within CRC. A unique biological context is offered by the gut, which houses two key components: an autonomous "second brain", namely the enteric nervous system (ENS), and the human body's largest immune organ. Consequently, this arrangement provides a natural platform supporting intensive neuro-immune crosstalk. At the central level, the classical brain-gut axis provides the physiological framework through which neuroendocrine and autonomic signals regulate intestinal and systemic immunity. Tumor-derived signals may functionally rewire this pre-existing network, thereby establishing a tumor-brain-immune circuit characterized by reciprocal signaling and positive-feedback amplification. In the periphery, nerve fibers of sympathetic, parasympathetic, and sensory origins regulate immune cell functions via neurotransmitters and neuropeptides-including norepinephrine, acetylcholine, CGRP, and substance P-which in turn drives immune suppression or tolerance. By contrast, neuronal activity and plasticity are modulated by immune cells through the production of neurotransmitter-like molecules and cytokines including IL-17A. In this process, glial cells-Schwann cells among them-serve as critical intermediaries. Given this context, emerging therapies directed against the neuro-immune axis include repurposed β-adrenergic blockers and neuropeptide receptor antagonists, together with neuromodulatory interventions such as vagus nerve stimulation and microbiota-based approaches. These therapies are promising avenues to overcome resistance to immunotherapy and to remodel the immune microenvironment of the tumor. It will be necessary for future investigations to integrate multi-omics profiling with precise neuromodulation technologies, so as to construct high-resolution maps of neuro-immune interactions and to advance interventions towards nerve subtype-specific precision. Ultimately, this effort will shift CRC treatment paradigms from immune precision toward neuro-immune precision.

related.title_zh: 胰臟癌、大腸直腸癌與胃癌中的腸道神經-免疫-腫瘤生態系統：情境依賴性與轉譯醫學優先方向

papers.title_zh: 大腸直腸癌中的神經-免疫交互作用：腫瘤免疫微環境中的機轉洞見與治療意涵
papers.abstract_zh: 在大腸直腸癌(CRC)微環境中，神經系統與免疫系統構成一個具高度動態性與雙向性的調控軸，深刻影響腫瘤發生、免疫逃逸與治療抗性。本文系統性整理CRC內神經-免疫交互作用的解剖與功能基礎、分子機轉及轉譯潛力。腸道提供獨特的生物情境，內含兩大關鍵組成：自主的「第二大腦」即腸神經系統(ENS)，以及人體最大的免疫器官。因此，此配置提供了支持密集神經-免疫交互作用的天然平台。在中樞層次，經典的腦-腸軸提供神經內分泌與自律神經訊號調控腸道及全身免疫的生理架構。腫瘤衍生訊號可能功能性地重塑此既存網絡，建立以互惠訊號傳遞與正向回饋放大為特徵的腫瘤-腦-免疫迴路。在周邊，交感、副交感及感覺神經纖維透過神經傳導物質與神經胜肽——包括正腎上腺素、乙醯膽鹼、CGRP與物質P——調控免疫細胞功能，進而驅動免疫抑制或耐受。相對地，神經元活性與可塑性則由免疫細胞透過產生類神經傳導物質分子及包括IL-17A在內的細胞激素來調節。在此過程中，膠質細胞——包括許旺氏細胞——扮演關鍵中介角色。基於此背景，針對神經-免疫軸的新興療法包括再利用的β腎上腺素阻斷劑與神經胜肽受體拮抗劑，以及迷走神經刺激等神經調控介入與微生物群導向策略。這些療法有望克服免疫治療抗性並重塑腫瘤免疫微環境。未來研究須整合多體學分析與精準神經調控技術，以建構高解析度的神經-免疫交互作用圖譜，並推動朝向神經亞型專一精準治療。最終，此努力將使CRC治療典範從免疫精準轉向神經-免疫精準。

papers.title: The microbiota-NK cell axis in colorectal cancer: a spatial and subset-centric framework
papers.authors: Wen J, Gao Y, Xu M, Li M, Dong X, Zhao M
papers.abstract: The gut microbiota and natural killer (NK) cells jointly shape colorectal cancer (CRC) progression and immunotherapy response, yet existing reviews largely adopt a linear, pathogen-centric view that overlooks NK-cell heterogeneity and spatial tumor microenvironment architecture. We propose an integrated framework centered on three progressive pillars: (i) the microbiota appears to selectively shape three well-characterized NK-cell states (activated, dysfunctional, and memory-like), with a fourth regulatory-like state that remains mechanistically uncharacterized through metabolically and genetically mediated mechanisms; (ii) emerging spatial evidence suggests beneficial commensals and activated NK cells preferentially localize to perivascular niches, whereas pathogenic bacteria and dysfunctional NK cells are enriched within the tumor parenchyma, though multicenter validation is needed; and (iii) these insights support two testable patient-stratification strategies for future clinical testing, an "enrichment" approach for tumors with pre-existing activated NK signatures, and a "remodeling" approach for Fusobacterium nucleatum (F. nucleatum)-dominant immunosuppressive microenvironments, particularly in refractory microsatellite-stable disease. This framework seeks to shift the field toward a subset-centric, spatially resolved, and clinically testable model of the microbiota-NK axis, designed to generate hypotheses and guide prospective cohort studies rather than replace current standards.
papers.title_zh: 大腸直腸癌中的微生物群-NK細胞軸：空間與亞群中心框架
papers.abstract_zh: 腸道微生物群與自然殺手（NK）細胞共同形塑大腸直腸癌（CRC）的進展與免疫治療反應，然而現有的綜述大多採取線性、病原體中心的觀點，忽略了NK細胞的異質性與腫瘤微環境的空間結構。我們提出一個以三個漸進支柱為核心的整合框架：（一）微生物群似乎透過代謝與基因調控機制，選擇性地形塑三種已被良好描述的NK細胞狀態（活化型、功能失調型、記憶樣型），並存在第四種尚未被機制性描述的調節樣狀態；（二）新興的空間證據顯示，有益共生菌與活化型NK細胞傾向於定位在血管周圍生態區，而致病菌與功能失調型NK細胞則富集於腫瘤實質內，惟仍需多中心驗證；（三）這些洞見支持兩種可供未來臨床測試的病人分層策略：針對已具有活化型NK特徵腫瘤的「強化」策略，以及針對以具核梭桿菌（F. nucleatum）為主之免疫抑制微環境（特別是難治型微衛星穩定型疾病）的「重塑」策略。本框架旨在推動該領域朝向以亞群為中心、空間解析、且可供臨床測試的微生物群-NK軸模型發展，其目的是產生假說並引導前瞻性世代研究，而非取代現行標準治療。

papers.title: From gut microbiota-driven mucosal barrier disruption to myeloid-dominant immunosuppressive niches in colorectal cancer
papers.authors: Lu N, Zhang L, Sun H, Zhou Y, He P, Zhao C
papers.abstract: Colorectal cancer (CRC) develops within a mucosal ecosystem in which epithelial barrier function, colonizing microbes, inflammatory signaling, and immune cell composition are closely interdependent. Immune checkpoint inhibitors have significantly altered treatment outcomes in patients with mismatch repair-deficient or microsatellite instability-high (dMMR/MSI-H) CRC, but most microsatellite-stable (MSS) tumors still respond poorly, and this is not solely due to lower antigenicity. This article explains this gap mechanistically: gut microbiota dysbiosis weakens the mucosal barrier, promotes microbial translocation, amplifies cytokine and eicosanoid signaling, and remodels the tumor microenvironment into an immunosuppressive state dominated by myeloid cells. We focus on Fusobacterium nucleatum and enterotoxigenic Bacteroides fragilis, microbial metabolites, tight junction disruption, and the IL-6/STAT3, NF-κB, TNF-alpha, and COX-2/PGE2 pathways that link epithelial stress with innate immune remodeling. Downstream processes include tumor-associated macrophages, myeloid-derived suppressor cells, neutrophil polarization, dendritic cell dysfunction, regulatory T cells, cancer-associated fibroblasts, CXCL12-mediated T-cell exclusion, and hypoxia. These processes collectively create a spatially structured drug-resistance niche, preventing effector T cells from functioning effectively, rather than simply resulting in an immunologically "cold" tumor. We believe that integrating this microbiota-barrier-myeloid axis into biomarker development and mechanism-matched combination therapy design offers a more rational and promising approach to overcoming immunotherapy resistance in CRC, especially in MSS disease, compared to empirical drug combinations.

papers.title_zh: 從腸道菌群驅動的黏膜屏障破壞到大腸直腸癌中骨髓細胞主導的免疫抑制利基
papers.abstract_zh: 大腸直腸癌(CRC)發生於黏膜生態系統中，上皮屏障功能、定植微生物、發炎訊號與免疫細胞組成密切相互依存。免疫檢查點抑制劑已顯著改變錯配修復缺陷或微衛星不穩定性高(dMMR/MSI-H)CRC患者的治療結果，但大多數微衛星穩定(MSS)腫瘤反應仍差，這並非僅因抗原性較低所致。本文從機轉層面解釋此差距：腸道菌群失衡削弱黏膜屏障、促進微生物移位、放大細胞因子與類花生酸訊號，並將腫瘤微環境重塑為以骨髓細胞主導的免疫抑制狀態。我們聚焦於具核梭桿菌(Fusobacterium nucleatum)與產腸毒素脆弱擬桿菌(ETBF)、微生物代謝物、緊密連接破壞，以及連結上皮壓力與先天免疫重塑的IL-6/STAT3、NF-κB、TNF-α與COX-2/PGE2通路。下游過程包括腫瘤相關巨噬細胞、骨髓源性抑制細胞、嗜中性球極化、樹突細胞功能異常、調節性T細胞、癌症相關纖維母細胞、CXCL12介導的T細胞排除，以及缺氧。這些過程共同創造出空間結構化的抗藥利基，阻止效應T細胞有效發揮功能，而非僅是形成免疫學上的「冷」腫瘤。我們認為，將此微生物群-屏障-骨髓軸整合入生物標記開發與機轉匹配的聯合治療設計，相較於經驗性藥物組合，是克服CRC（特別是MSS疾病）免疫治療抗藥性更合理且有前景的方法。

papers.title: Decoding the power of the microbiome in human health
papers.journal_full: Frontiers in cellular and infection microbiology
papers.authors: Kumar M, Almohannadi N, Al Khodor S
papers.abstract: The human microbiota plays a vital role in maintaining physiological homeostasis and overall health. Microbial communities colonize distinct anatomical sites, including the gut, oral cavity, respiratory tract, and skin, where they engage in symbiotic interactions with the host. These site-specific microbial communities contribute to essential functions such as nutrient metabolism, vitamin and short-chain fatty acid (SCFA) synthesis, immune regulation, and epithelial barrier integrity. Disruption of this balance, known as dysbiosis, is increasingly linked to a wide range of diseases, including inflammatory bowel disease (IBD), obesity, diabetes, and cancer. In this review, we summarize the current understanding of the human microbiota, highlighting its role in vitamin biosynthesis, the gut-brain axis, and immune modulation. We further the role of microbiome alterations in disease pathogenesis and outline emerging microbiome-based therapeutic strategies aimed at restoring microbial homeostasis.

papers.title_zh: 解碼人類健康中微菌叢的力量
papers.abstract_zh: 人類微菌叢在維持生理恆定與整體健康上扮演關鍵角色。微生物群落定殖於不同解剖部位，包括腸道、口腔、呼吸道與皮膚，與宿主進行共生互動。這些部位特異性微生物群落參與營養代謝、維生素與短鏈脂肪酸（SCFA）合成、免疫調節及上皮屏障完整性等重要功能。此平衡的破壞，稱為菌叢失衡（dysbiosis），日益與多種疾病相關，包括發炎性腸道疾病（IBD）、肥胖、糖尿病與癌症。本綜述總結目前對人類微菌叢的理解，聚焦其在維生素生合成、腸-腦軸與免疫調節中的角色。我們進一步探討微菌叢改變在疾病致病機轉中的作用，並概述新興以微菌叢為基礎、旨在恢復微生物恆定的治療策略。

papers.title: Patterns of Cancer Frequency in Balochistan: Regional Perspectives and Implications for Cancer Control
papers.journal_full: Journal of the College of Physicians and Surgeons--Pakistan : JCPSP
papers.authors: Safdar F, Arshad S, Zaib L, Sirzameen R, Pervez S
papers.abstract:
OBJECTIVE: To evaluate the distribution of cancers across different age groups among residents of Balochistan from 2021 to 2024 and compare these patterns with those observed in other provinces of Pakistan.
STUDY DESIGN: An observational study. Place and Duration of the Study: Pathology-based cancer registry at the Section of Histopathology, Department of Pathology and Laboratory Medicine, Aga Khan University Hospital, Karachi, Pakistan, and Department of Pathology, Aria Institute of Medical Sciences, Quetta, Pakistan, from January 2021 to December 2024.
METHODOLOGY: Newly diagnosed, biopsy-confirmed malignant cases received from Quetta and other cities of Balochistan through the Aga Khan University Hospital laboratory network and the collaborating Institute over four years from the cancer registry and one year from the other institute were analysed. Patients were grouped by age and gender into children (0-14 years), adolescents (15-19 years), and adults (≥20 years). Duplicate records were removed through systematic verification. Categorical variables were evaluated using frequencies and percentages.
RESULTS: Out of 16,342 biopsy specimens, 5,145 (31.5%) were malignant. There were 52% (n = 2,659) male and 48% (n = 2,486) female cases. Adults accounted for 93% of cases, while children and adolescents accounted for 7%. Among a total of 2,438 adult males, oesophageal cancer was most frequent (425, 17.4%), followed by stomach (351, 14.4%) and colorectal cancers (225, 9.2%). Out of the total 2,351 adult females, breast cancer was the leading malignancy (526, 22.4%), followed by oesophageal (434, 18.5%) and colorectal cancers (133, 5.7%). In younger groups, brain tumours and lymphomas predominated.
CONCLUSION: Marked predominance of oesophageal cancer in both genders highlights substantial regional variation. Overall, the predominance of gastrointestinal cancers suggests the presence of region-specific environmental risk factors.
KEY WORDS: Cancer registry, Balochistan, Oesophageal cancer, Colorectal cancer.

papers.title: Pediatric venous thromboembolism: an illustrated review
papers.journal_full: Research and practice in thrombosis and haemostasis
papers.abstract: Venous thromboembolism (VTE) in children has historically been considered uncommon; however, it is increasingly recognized in hospitalized pediatric populations, and its incidence has risen over the past few decades. This can be attributed to several factors, including greater awareness of the condition, improved survival rates for children with chronic and complex medical conditions, increased use of supportive care (such as central venous catheters), and advancements in diagnostic imaging. Acquired conditions, such as infections, malignancies, cardiovascular diseases, and inflammatory bowel disease, are recognized as risk factors for VTE. Among these, the presence of a central venous catheter remains the most significant and common risk factor for pediatric VTE. In this review, we present and illustrate the pathophysiology and current treatment options for VTE in the pediatric population.
papers.title_zh: 兒童靜脈血栓栓塞症：圖解回顧
papers.abstract_zh: 兒童靜脈血栓栓塞症（VTE）過去被認為並不常見；然而，近年來在住院兒童族群中越來越被認識到，其發生率在過去數十年間持續上升。這可歸因於多項因素，包括對此疾病認識的提升、患有慢性及複雜疾病兒童存活率的改善、支持性照護（如中心靜脈導管）使用的增加，以及診斷影像技術的進步。後天性疾病，如感染、惡性腫瘤、心血管疾病及發炎性腸道疾病，已被認定為VTE的危險因子。其中，中心靜脈導管的存在仍是兒童VTE最重要且最常見的危險因子。本篇綜述介紹並以圖解方式呈現兒童VTE的病理生理機制及現行治療選項。

papers.title: The impact for causal associations between common diseases and inflammatory bowel disease: a disease-wide bidirectional Mendelian randomization study
papers.journal_full: Inflammation research : official journal of the European Histamine Research Society ... [et al.]
papers.authors: Sun Y, Liang Z, Ou Z, Gao L, Wang Y, Yuan J
papers.abstract:
OBJECTIVES: Observational studies on associations between various diseases and inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) are often limited by confounding and reverse causation. We aimed to assess potential causal relationships between a wide range of diseases and IBD, including Crohn's disease (CD) and ulcerative colitis (UC).
METHODS: We performed a comprehensive bidirectional Mendelian randomization (MR) analysis of 104 common diseases and IBD traits using the generalized summary-data-based MR (GSMR) approach. Genome-wide association study (GWAS) summary statistics for diseases were obtained from the MRC Integrative Epidemiology Unit, and IBD data from the International IBD Genetics Consortium. Summary-data-based MR (SMR) integrating GWAS and expression quantitative trait locus data was applied to identify pleiotropic genes associated with IBD.
RESULTS: MR analyses identified 38, 34, and 52 exposures significantly associated with IBD, UC, and CD, respectively. Childhood- and adult-onset asthma showed distinct causal effects on UC and CD. Reverse MR indicated associations between IBD traits and 15 diseases, including multiple sclerosis. SMR identified RGS14 and CARD9 as pleiotropic genes linked to IBD, suggesting shared genetic mechanisms with asthma and multiple sclerosis.
CONCLUSIONS: These findings provide evidence for causal links and shared immune-related genetic mechanisms underlying IBD, highlighting potential targets for future research.

papers.abstract_zh: 目的：關於各種疾病與發炎性腸道疾病（IBD）之關聯的觀察性研究，常受限於混雜因子與反向因果關係。我們旨在評估廣泛疾病與IBD（包括克隆氏症CD與潰瘍性結腸炎UC）之間潛在的因果關係。方法：我們使用廣義摘要資料孟德爾隨機化（GSMR）方法，對104種常見疾病與IBD相關特徵進行了全面的雙向孟德爾隨機化（MR）分析。疾病的全基因組關聯研究（GWAS）摘要統計資料來自MRC整合流行病學單位，IBD資料來自國際IBD遺傳學聯盟。應用整合GWAS與表現量性狀基因位點（eQTL）資料的摘要資料孟德爾隨機化（SMR）方法，以鑑定與IBD相關的多效性基因。結果：MR分析分別鑑定出38、34、52個與IBD、UC、CD顯著相關的暴露因子。兒童期發病與成人期發病氣喘對UC與CD顯示出不同的因果效應。反向MR顯示IBD特徵與15種疾病（包括多發性硬化症）存在關聯。SMR鑑定出RGS14與CARD9為與IBD相關的多效性基因，提示其與氣喘及多發性硬化症具有共同的基因機制。結論：這些發現為IBD潛在的因果關聯與共同免疫相關基因機制提供證據，並突顯未來研究的潛在目標。
